adaptations: Safari releases native held keys after each button activation.
Only the ptwiki host guards are extended to localhost for this isolated fixture.
All API responses are local mocks. No production text or parser logic is altered.
Minor-edit checkbox cases use native focus and Space. Custom selective-diff controls were retired by user request and are not counted as passing.
The real Worker constructor is observed only to retain result counts for independent UI assertions.
The historical city source exercises the ordinary native-diff shortcut; its already corrected recent revision is retained unchanged in the 31-article corpus.
Installation workflows begin in the ordinary source editor. A separate read-only view confirms both lazy loader and full core add no extra section controls and leave all native links intact.
